cohort: The study included 7,308 women who underwent single blastocyst transfer during frozen embryo transfer (FET) cycles and achieved singleton live births from January 2015 to June 2022.
finding: Good-quality blastocysts were associated with a decreased cesarean section rate and an increased likelihood of having a male child, with no differences observed in other neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Good-quality blastocysts were associated with a decreased cesarean section rate.
